name: com.matrixdigitalltd.agents/matrix-agent-tools
title: Matrix Agent Tools
description: Autonomous commerce, checkout and tender analysis tools with per-job USDC payments.

tools.name: matrix_catalogue
tools.description: Discover Matrix products, pricing, payment networks and release availability.

tools.name: matrix_quote
tools.description: Create an unpaid, tenant-bound Base Mainnet USDC quotation for one offline analysis job. Use matrix_catalogue first to check current product pricing and admission availability. Requires an enrolled machine bearer credential. Supply the released analysis route, its matching product payload and a unique idempotency key. The same key and identical request recover the existing quote; changed requests can conflict. This creates a quotation record but does not charge the wallet or start execution. The response contains quote_id, price in USD cents, expiry timestamp, payment_url and status_url. Approve the amount before authorizing payment through the returned x402 payment URL. Use matrix_job_status for subsequent recovery. Do not request another quote merely because a payment or execution response is delayed.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated unique identifier for the logical job. Use a fresh key for a genuinely new job and reuse the identical key and payload for retries. Do not generate another key to recover an uncertain payment.

payload.description: Product-specific analysis input. Checkout Monitor uses captured journeys and events; Commerce Guard uses supplied commerce HTML/feed; Tender Intelligence uses supplier/tender data; MCP Security Audit uses supplied server/tool metadata; Ad Tracking Guard uses supplied page analysis data. These are offline inputs, not permission to scan a live network target. See the examples and public integration documentation.

route.description: Exact released offline analysis API route. Choose the route corresponding to the desired product. Availability is dynamic; consult matrix_catalogue before requesting.

tools.name: matrix_job_status
tools.description: Retrieve the current payment, execution and result status of an existing quotation owned by the authenticated machine. Use after requesting a quote or submitting an x402 authorization, including recovery after connection loss or process restart. Requires the original quote_id and an authorized machine bearer credential. This tool does not submit payment, execute a new job, modify existing results or issue refunds. Returns payment_verified, execution state, job_id when available, and result when completed. A pending payment or execution is not a reason to create another charge. A quote_expired state alone is not finalized non-payment evidence. Inspect payment_resolution for finalized unpaid closure and refund for failed or cancelled paid jobs when those fields are present.

quote_id.description: The original server-issued quotation ID, returned by matrix_quote or the marketplace payment challenge. This is not the execution job_id, wallet address or transaction hash. The quotation must belong to the authenticated machine.
